svg.title: Fira Code Inspired Pairs
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 41 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Short fixed pairs cover pipes, brackets, hash operators, dots, and slashes.
短固定组合覆盖管道、括号、井号操作符、点号和斜线。

g.text: Hash-prefixed operators such as #{ / #[ stay separate from Markdown heading badges.
#{ / #[ 这类井号操作符和 Markdown 标题徽标分开处理。
